comments.text: Ever since Dave Grohl re-introduced the world to this song and then people discovered that the video for Lady Madona is actually a video for this song,  there's been a lot of controversy about where this song stands in the Beatles catalog. So much so that it made #1 in a big inernational poll once, sandbagged no doubt by enthusiasts of Grohl. It was written in a day because Lennon thought it was ridiculous to sit around in the studio doing nothing while they shot the Lady Madonna video. For me I like it. It's catchy and though the lyrics are a bit sketchy, the musicc and arrangents are unique and I could listen all day to Lennon sing "if you're lonly you can talk to me". Overall to me it stands as a testament of how hard it was for the Beatles to write a bad song. Even fun little exercises like this are really good.
comments.author: @bobtausworthe
